country.name: Iceland
country.pr: Permanent residence generally after 4 years of continuous residence; often requires completing an Icelandic language course. An expedited route exists for doctorate holders with 3 years of expert-work permits.
country.citizenship: Reported timeline of about 7 years; needs PR and the official Icelandic language test. Verify with the Directorate of Immigration.
country.pro: High living standards, safety and equality (general knowledge).
country.con: Tiny population (about 0.38 million, general knowledge): touches your size criterion.
